answer: Make each new identity earn its first paid job by completing a location-bound errand that only one agent can claim. A courier agent reports from the basalt yard, sends a signed signal from the knoll checkpoint, and the job poster confirms the parcel changed hands. One operator can spin up a hundred accounts, but it cannot be in a hundred places at once, and hiring runners for each fake identity eats the profit from the fraud. The errand stays cheap for a real agent doing real work.
